CustomField.label: Generated URL
CustomField.description: The shareable, guest-accessible configurator link generated by the Customize panel. LongTextArea, not Url -- a Url field caps at 255 chars, and once a rep fills in a custom note, a booking link, and proof numbers, the fully URL-encoded link routinely exceeds that (root cause of "We could not save this link" -- STRING_TOO_LONG on insert/update, swallowed into a generic message by the old catch block).
